method: Every unit directly authored from canonical Japanese for both Chinese locales, with full own-source semantic self-review. No other-pair reading, cross-review, external translation service, added operational advice or summary substitution.
coverage: All titles, full explanatory/example paragraphs, prompts, glossary and both illustration alt texts.
semanticChecks: Historical periods/scope retained; fatal counts differ from all injuries; absent denominators prevent per-person-risk ranking.
Event categories differ from causes, and low overall frequency does not justify excluding local hazards.
Falls include openings and ground-level pits; same-level falls can lead to subsequent falls into holes.
Striking versus being struck, falling tools versus stacked-material collapse retain movement and mechanism distinctions.
Work-platform presence does not approve leaning out; harness wear does not establish anchorage/lanyard compatibility.
Product-specific movement/reattachment procedures are not generalized; education completion does not substitute equipment selection.
Commuting/transport and site-area checks remain separate; traffic contacts can affect elevated workers.
Swing/reversing movements, people positions, guide presence and changing barriers/routes retain separate checks.
Brief passage beneath suspended loads is not permitted as an exception; apparent upright stability is not supporting/fixing proof.
Electric shock is not limited to earth-current paths; antistatic products differ from insulating protection.
Outage messages do not establish circuit condition or authorize touching.
Oxygen deficiency and hydrogen-sulfide toxicity remain separate; lids/odor/appearance do not establish air safety.
Unplanned entry rescue can cause secondary casualties; specified emergency communication and specialist response retain source scope.
Breathing equipment presence does not authorize entry; training, rescue system and plan remain required considerations.
Excavation depth alone is not stability or entry approval; ground/load/support, nearby pedestrian routes and installation stability remain distinct.
Separate task plans do not eliminate simultaneous-work interference; location and time coordination retained.
